Nora Vega: Quick poke  the cost preview for route 'nlp-search' claims -11% with quantized model but our nightly chargeback shows -1%. anyone want to sanity-check assumptions?
Diego Alvarez: Two places to check: 1) preview used optimistic batching/kv assumptions; 2) one-off quantization cost amortization window.
Nora Vega: Where are those set? I only see a single slider in Console.
Priya Narayanan: We added preview metadata keys months ago: batch_profile, kv_hit_rate, amortization_days, sample_rate. Console only surfaces slider. Example API: POST /api/cost_preview {"route":"nlp-search","batch_profile":"aggressive","kv_hit_rate":0.8,"amortization_days":7,"sample_rate":1.0} but billing pipeline uses batch_profile=observed, kv_hit_rate based on sampled telemetry and amortization_days=30.
Diego Alvarez: TL;DR: Preview shows short-term snapshot savings; billing amortizes transcode costs and observed batching erodes most savings.
Nora Vega: Can Console show a compact diff of assumptions so owners don't get surprised? e.g., header: "Assumptions: batch=aggressive vs observed; kv=80% vs 45%; amort=7d vs 30d"
Priya Narayanan: Love that. Also add a confidence band computed from sample_rate variance: Low/Medium/High. We'll return keys estimation_diff and confidence_band from the API.
Nora Vega: And please add a small red disclaimer when using non-default advanced settings: "Non-default assumptions may deviate from billing."
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-8302 "preview: expose assumption diff & confidence band"
Diego Alvarez: I'll prototype the header diff + red banner. Priya, can you add a regression test that compares preview->chargeback within 8% for routes with sample_rate>=0.5?
Priya Narayanan: Yep filing test now and linking to ticket.
Nora Vega: Great, thanks everyone.
